Please note that https://support.mozilla.org/en-US/kb/thunderbird-and-junk-spam-messages does not address the problem I am having. I have disabled adaptive spam controls in the Yahoo account and for Thunderbird in general, and I still see two Spam folders in my Yahoo account.

To sum up the issue: in the Yahoo app and on the Yahoo Mail site, my Yahoo account has *1* Spam folder. Thunderbird shows *2,* and I cannot correct this myself.
